text:
jamie: Quick experiment proposal for the pricing page calculator: add a tiny "Choose your path" toggle under results (3 pills): Demo | Webinar | Self-serve. One click sets the CTA and routes events. Keeps the main UX intact but captures intent.

kiran: Love the lightweight approach. Can we make the pill labels dynamic based on calc output? e.g., if estimated spend > $2k => show Demo first.

sofia: Copy input: for the pill states we should test CTA text too: "Book a demo" vs "Talk to sales" and "Join webinar" vs "See a short walkthrough". Small wording shifts matter.

ryan: Analytics note 1: add UTM and session_id into the event payload so we can tie back to GA. Sample: 
```
window.dataLayer.push({
  event: 'pricing_path_select',
  path: 'demo|webinar|self',
  calc_estimate_usd: 2200,
  utm_source: 'docs',
  session_id: 'sess_xxx'
});
```
We can later map session_id -> user in BigQuery for funnel joins.

priyanka: Sales ops: threshold idea looks good but prefer a floor of $1.5k/mo ARR for SDR routing. Anything above gets an SDR lead, with a property lead_score: 'enterprise|mid|small'. We also want a flag in the payload: is_enterprise_candidate: true/false.

jamie: Good. Let's run a 14-day A/B: control = no pills (current), variant = pills. Primary metric = demo bookings per visitor; secondary = webinar signups, time-on-page.

sofia: UX note: show a one-line FAQ toggle directly under the pills for Demo path: "Reserved capacity includes SLA and priority support". For Self-serve keep FAQ link to full pricing FAQ.

kiran: Tier naming test idea: in the pills we can show two naming sets across variants (micro-test): Set A = Reserved / Burst / Managed ; Set B = Dedicated / Flexible / Hosted. Only experiment in the pill labels + microcopy. No site-wide rename.

ryan: Tracking checklist: event pricing_path_select, click_to_cta, cta_conversion, webinar_attend. Add experiment_id and variant_id fields.

analytics-bot: Note: experiment created: pricing_path_pills_v1 (exp_id=exp_98123). Start date 2026-05-04. Variant assignment handled via client-side experiment service.

priyanka: Sales follow-up: if path=demo and calc_estimate_usd>1500, webhook to /webhooks/sdr with payload {email, calc_estimate_usd, path, is_enterprise_candidate}. Please include preferred_cta_text so SDR sees which wording converted.

jamie: Timeline: quick mock by Tue, measurement plan + fields by Wed, dev build Thurs, staging QA Fri, 10% rollout Mon.

sofia: I'll mock the pill visuals and microcopy variants today. ETA 6pm.

kiran: Small accessibility ask: pills should be keyboard-focusable and announce the selected state.

ryan: Also recommend adding a debounce so repeated toggles in same session don't spam events; only send pricing_path_select once per session or on final CTA click.

analytics-bot: Reminder: include experiment metadata in all events: {exp_id: 'exp_98123', variant: 'A|B'}.

jamie: Perfect. One more: can marketing run a short micro-survey (1 question) after CTA click asking "Was this helpful?" free text optional. We'll A/B with vs without to measure friction.

priyanka: Fine with survey but make it non-intrusive. Also mask prompt content for privacy in any lead payloads.

sofia: Mock includes survey scaffold.

analytics-bot: deploy scheduled: marketing/pricing-path-pills -> staging 2026-05-01T09:00:00Z.

jamie: Thanks team. I'll update the experiment doc and add the KPI dashboard template. :party_popper:
